messages:
Anne: FYI ACME wants a private-pilot demo next month with a 99.9% p99 SLA and a short demo burst: 3x qps for 5m. Need a checklist + owners by EOD Tue.

Carl: Which day exactly? we need to lock the calendar to hit certs/deploy windows.

Anne: They said week of 1763000000, tentative. Customer expects us to sign off this week.

Morgan: infra: 3x for 5m OK if we prewarm or reserve burst slots. Need instance type + region (us-west-2 preferred). Otherwise cold-starts will blow p99.

Carl: runtime: need model artifact (size, kv cache usage) and whether we can use a quantized fallback for bursts. A q4_7b fallback could save ~2-3x latency.

Devon: security: ACME requires HSM-backed keys + per-request audit logs. Also VPC whitelist and staging connector. Certs + KMS policy review is 48-72h.

Sophie: ops: propose a route-level SLO with automatic fallback to the quantized model when p99 > threshold. Add a canary flag for the pilot route and temporary high-trace retention during demo.

Riley: SRE: I'll run the 3x/5m simulation in staging once infra & runtime confirm. Drop exact QPS number and model size and I will schedule soak.

Tessa: Product acceptance checklist draft: 1) p99 verified in staging under 3x burst, 2) fallback model validated for quality and correctness, 3) HSM/KMS audit pass + certs, 4) VPC/network whitelisting done, 5) route canary + automatic fallback enabled, 6) runbook + rollback steps documented.

Deploy-bot: reserved-capacity request queued (#INC-7342) - awaiting instance_type and region.

InfraBot: predictive-prewarm job scheduled when capacity commit confirmed.

Anne: Action owners: Carl/runtime - model sizing + fallback perf numbers by EOD tomorrow. Morgan/infra - confirm instance_type + reserve burst slots. Devon/security - start certs & KMS paperwork. Sophie/ops - create route SLO + enable canary. Riley/SRE - plan stress run after confirmations. Tessa/product - finalize acceptance checklist.

Carl: I'll test LLM-7B-q4 fallback and post perf table.

Morgan: leaning g5.48xlarge in us-west-2 for latency. If ACME demo needs EU region, we need lead time for capacity. Reserving burst slots for 5m is cheap but requires short commit.

Devon: starting KMS/HSM intake now. Send CIDR(s) to whitelist and I'll open cert ticket.

Sophie: I'll set fallback trigger at p99 > 450ms for 1m initially, we can tune after staging.

Anne: Thanks. I'll consolidate the checklist, assign Jira tasks, and ping owners. :thumbsup:
